proposal.title: Restructure external product impacts — Realistic CTR-41 cassette recorder
proposal.reason: Consolidate descriptive content and move assessed product/standard effects into typed impact sections. Preserve historical interfaces, fictional-world boundaries and qualification limits. Evidence: data_storytelling/review_evidence/external-impact-revision/assessment.json.

before.name: Realistic CTR-41 cassette recorder
before.description: Realistic CTR-41 cassette recorder is a storage peripheral for TRS-80 and suitable cassette-interface micros.

specification.description: Consumer audio recorder used for program storage through the host's cassette interface. The intended host environment is {host}. Interfaces, cabling and software must match that configuration.

Assessment at 1979-12-31. Cassette storage supports its own host workflow. No cassette-based Logix product or qualified cassette bridge is recorded; it is not a drop-in replacement for FlexiDisk. No direct product impact is assigned.
Assessment at 1979-12-31. Audio recording formats and transport control are not the FlexiBUS disk class. Shared use of a serial or cassette connection establishes no standards adoption.
